name: 90DaysOfDevOps
description: This repository started out as a learning in public project for myself and has now become a structured learning map for many in the community. We have 3 years under our belt covering all things DevOps, including Principles, Processes, Tooling and Use Cases surrounding this vast topic.
one_liner: A free, structured 90-day study plan that teaches someone DevOps from scratch, written by one person's public learning journal.
buyer: A corporate training manager at a company that needs to upskill junior sysadmins into DevOps engineers without paying for an expensive bootcamp.
business_use_cases: A training company licenses or adapts the structure into a paid, instructor-led cohort course with live mentoring and certificates.
A career-change bootcamp uses the free curriculum as marketing content, then upsells a paid, accelerated and mentored version.
A corporate L&D team runs internal 90-day DevOps upskilling cohorts for junior staff, using this as the free syllabus backbone.

money_ideas.idea: Paid cohort-based course with live mentorship and project reviews on top of the free curriculum.
Corporate training licensing/workshops sold to companies upskilling their own staff.

steal_this: Use the free content as a lead magnet this weekend: build a simple landing page offering a paid, 2-week-accelerated, mentor-reviewed version of the same 90-day plan.
